description: Generate a static QR code as SVG (default, up to 2000 px), PNG base64 or data URL (up to 1024 px) from data or a payload object. Bulk (/v1/qr/bulk, ≤50) is SVG-only, ≤256 bytes per item. Static codes only: no redirects, no dynamic/editable codes, no scan analytics. EAN/UPC output is format-valid (check digit) and is NOT GS1 registration. Scannability is not guaranteed (contrast, print size, quiet zone and reader all matter).
name: qr_generate
title: Generate a static QR code
